title: Shut Doors
summary: Thornhaven's opinion of the player has fallen far enough that the village closes ranks.

hooks.situation: Nobody in Thornhaven has a good word for {player} any more. Shutters close when they walk past, and you have to decide whether yours does.

options.label: Tell them the village would sleep easier if they left

effects.text: Tell {player} the village would sleep easier if they took the Kingsroad east, and soon.

options.label: Give them nothing: no bread, no bed, no answers

effects.text: Give {player} nothing: no bread, no bed, no answers. Be polite if you must.

options.label: Tell them what people say, and that it can still be mended

effects.text: Tell {player} what people are saying about them, and that in Thornhaven it is not too late to mend it.

options.label: Say nothing; keep your shutters closed
